description: The user's Luala spaces: their personal one and any shared one they are in, each with its own characters, photos and credits. Each has its id (the value the other tools take as space), its name, whether it is personal or shared, the user's role there (owner or member) and its balance. The tools act in the personal space unless given another. When the user has more than one and hasn't said which a shoot or a list is for, ask.
name: list_spaces
title: List spaces
